full_judgment: 2. The fact of the case lies in a very short compass. The opposite parties as plaintiff instituted Other Suit No. 156 of 1985 against the petitioners as defendant for permanent injunction in respect of 0.22 sataks of land in plot No. 3191 stating, inter-alia, that the schedule land belonged to Hasmat Ali Fakir, who by a registered sale deed dated 17-10-1962 transferred the same to his 2nd wife Azimunnessa and daughter, the plaintiff No. 2 and handed over the possession to them. Azimunnessa thereafter transferred her share in favour of the plaintiff No. 1 vide two sale deeds dated 18-9-76 and 2-8-82 and a Deed of Exchange dated 5-5-82. The plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 being owners of the schedule land have been possessing the same over 12 years and also mutated their names in the khatian and paid rents to the Government. The name of the defendant No. 2 is Fazilatunnessa @ Chalema but she alleging herself as the transferee of deed dated 17-10-1962 along with other defendants threatened the plaintiff on 20-5-1985 with dispossession. Hence, the present suit.
